messages:
mira-sales: ACME POC stuck during onboarding: SSO failing and SCIM user push not creating accounts. Can we triage?
sam-solutions: Hi — can you paste the SCIM HTTP response and the SAML error?
devon-acme: SCIM POST returns 401 initially. We rotated a secret yesterday so that might be it. SAML shows: 'Invalid SP EntityID' when users try to login.
lee-iam: 401 usually means token mismatch. Confirm the app is sending: Authorization: Bearer <scim_token_from_admin>. Also check there are no surrounding quotes.
devon-acme: We were using the token from our notes (old). Replaced with the new token from your Admin UI. Now SCIM returns 400: "invalid payload: missing emails[0].value".
sam-solutions: Ok, two separate things then. For the SAML EntityID: what did they configure vs what we expect?
devon-acme: Their IdP is set to https://app.redwood.example/saml, screenshot shows our metadata expects https://poc.redwood.ai/saml/sp.
lee-iam: We can add a temporary alias to accept the old EntityID for this tenant while they update. I'll request a config change.
infra-bot: Config change requested (alias-add). Change ref: cfg-98120. Status: pending.
lee-iam: For SCIM payload, IdPs sometimes map primaryEmail differently. We expect either userName or emails[0].value. Example minimal payload we accept: ```{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"devon@acme","emails":[{"value":"devon@acme","primary":true}]}```
devon-acme: Thanks, updated Okta mapping to map 'email' -> emails[0].value and retried. SCIM now returns 201 and 24 users created.
infra-bot: cfg-98120 approved and applied at 2026-03-20T09:14:20Z.
mira-sales: Awesome progress. Lee — can you send a one-paragraph note about SCIM token rotation for their security team?
lee-iam: Sent in DM: "SCIM tokens are tenant-scoped API tokens created in the Redwood Admin console. Tokens can be rotated at any time; rotation immediately invalidates previous tokens. Token use is logged and included in audit exports."
mira-sales: Great — I'll update the POC ticket and confirm next steps for Dedicated pool networking. Thanks team.
